q.line: She must be tired of something
stanza: She says, "It's only in my head"
She says, "Shh, I know it's only in my head"
But the girl on the car in the parking lot
Says, "Man, you should try to take a shot
Can't you see my walls are crumbling?"
Then she looks up at the building
And says she's thinking of jumping
She says she's tired of life
She must be tired of something

partner.line: And says she's thinking of jumping

stanza: I'm always running from something
I push it back, but it keeps on coming
And being clever never got me very far
Because it's all in my head

I said, "Okay, but let's discuss this at the hospital"

partner.line: I push it back, but it keeps on coming

q.line: Then there was a silence you took to mean something:
stanza: Then there was a silence you took to mean something:
Mean, Run, sing
For alive you will evermore be
And the plague of the greasy black engines a-skulking
Has gone east
While you’re left to explain them to me —
Released
From their hairless and blind cavalry

partner.line: And the plague of the greasy black engines a-skulking

q.line: But oh la la, I gave up something
stanza: I used to need a couple people keep my head down
Now I need a whole lot more to keep me on the ground
But oh la la, I gave up something
And I gave it up for nothing
And I'm a failure now

partner.line: And I gave it up for nothing
